name: Moldovan Citizenship by Naturalisation, Marriage Ground (Law No. 253/2025, Art. 14(1)(d))

requirements.blocker_text: 3 years of marriage to a Moldovan citizen, combined with continuous residence in Moldova for that same period.
requirements.fix_path: Remain married and continuously resident in Moldova for 3 years.

requirements.blocker_text: Romanian language proficiency and basic knowledge of the Constitution (Art. 15) -- applies across all naturalisation grounds under the new law, marriage included.
requirements.fix_path: Pass the required language and civics examination.

evidence_required.document: Proof of continuous residence during the marriage
Romanian language and civics test certificate
